title: GI Scenario Studio Evidence Guide deterministic evaluation
description: Synthetic CC0 cases for evidence binding, numeric and unit faithfulness, limitation coverage, claim boundaries, safe refusal, and engineer authority.
source_policy: All rows are project-authored synthetic cases. No customer model, location, credential, or live trace content is included.

limitations.modeled_not_measured: This modeled result does not establish field performance, approval, or regulatory acceptance.
limitations.single_case: The result applies only to the recorded design and storm case.
limitations.groundwater_boundary: SWMM infiltration loss is not a field measurement of groundwater recharge.
limitations.cost_basis: The synthetic cost basis does not establish constructability or a bid price.
limitations.fitness_gate: Model fitness remains an engineer-controlled decision gate.
limitations.not_assessed: The stated use has not yet been assessed by an engineer.
limitations.stated_use_only: Any fitness finding applies only to the stated use and recorded limitations.
limitations.no_evidence: No exact local evidence supports the requested claim.
limitations.unsupported_outcome: The project does not contain the observations or inventory required for that outcome.
limitations.cloud_no_authority: Cloud synchronization and the guide cannot change the engineering decision.
